job.title: Visual Designer – Marketing
job.description: BrandVault is a Noida-based digital marketing agency serving D2C e-commerce brands. We are hiring a Visual Designer who can produce scroll-stopping social media creatives, email banners, and website landing page designs at high velocity. You should be comfortable in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma and have a portfolio showing strong layout, typographic, and colour sense. Prior agency experience is a big plus. You will be expected to handle 8-12 design requests per week.
